The Magnusson 20oz claw hammer is a robust tool designed for general construction, demolition, and carpentry tasks. Durable construction makes it ideal for builders, roofers, and serious DIY users handling framing, prying, and nail removal. Featuring a heat-treated and rim-tempered high-carbon steel head, the hammer offers excellent strength and longevity. The fibreglass shaft, combined with an ergonomic soft-grip handle, ensures comfortable use and reduced vibration during prolonged work, providing reliable performance on site.
